notes: «عن أمه» is a bare relation: the mother is not named in the text
«فاطمة بنت رسول الله» is written with the Prophet's name as nasab: read as a named narrator, not as the Prophet, who is the end of a chain (rule 12); not identified here
«وأبو معاوية» is a co-transmitter at the same level as إسماعيل بن إبراهيم (rule 2)
